brief.brief: Create an original personalized ceramic mug gift with a simple blue botanical line drawing and the exact large text ALEX. Deliver isolated flat print artwork on a plain white canvas, a lifestyle mockup with the print facing the camera, and a silent 5-second vertical product showcase. Keep the exact artwork and ALEX lettering readable and consistent across all assets. No extra text, trademarks, music, invented claims or customer testimonials.

criteria.description: Lifestyle mug mockup displays the exact same print artwork, the printed side faces directly toward the camera, no deviations in botanical line drawing or 'ALEX' lettering from the original design.

prompts.design: Isolated flat print artwork on a completely plain pure white background, minimalist personalized ceramic mug design: simple thin uniform blue botanical line drawing surrounding large bold uppercase perfectly legible text 'ALEX'. No other text, no logos, no shadows, no extra decorative elements, clean flat 2D vector line art style.
prompts.mockup: Photorealistic lifestyle product mockup of a matte white ceramic mug printed with the exact reference design: simple blue botanical line drawing and large clear 'ALEX' text, the printed side of the mug faces directly toward the camera, soft neutral indoor gift setting, no objects obscuring the design, natural even lighting.
prompts.video: Silent 5-second vertical 9:16 product showcase video of the ceramic mug with consistent identical reference print: slow smooth subtle rotation that keeps the 'ALEX' text and blue botanical artwork clearly visible and fully readable at all times, no audio, no music, no text overlays, plain neutral light background.

report.summary: All required deliverables fully meet the acceptance criteria. The flat artwork, lifestyle mockup, and 5-second vertical product video have consistent matching design with blue botanical line art and clearly legible 'ALEX' text, no unauthorized content, and align with the target personalized gift audience for US TikTok shoppers ages 25-44.
